**Shankaransh Srivastava** COO & Co-Founder
SmartHelio

Marketing Manager
SmartHelio


## **About the event**


In this high-energy, hands-on session learn how to deploy **GAIA Lens** on your monitoring platform in minutes.


See real use cases come to life as AI cuts through noise, highlights critical issues, and automates hours of daily analysis.


Save valuable time every day and **focus on what truly matters** , better decisions and higher performance.


Works seamlessly with leading monitoring platforms: GreenPowerMonitor (DNV), SynaptiQ, 3E, AlsoEnergy, Huawei, Sungrow, Meteocontrol (VCOM), Power Factors, Solar-Log, SolarEdge, Fronius…


## Who should Attend


-


**Executives & Asset Owners**
Understand how modern, data-led operations are improving scalability, risk visibility, and portfolio performance across renewable assets.


-


**O&M & Asset Management Leaders**
Learn how automation and predictive insights reduce manual workload and enable more proactive, day-to-day operations.


-


**Investors & Project Leaders**
See how next-generation operational models are reshaping asset value, cost efficiency, and long-term performance planning.


-


**Energy & Digital Professionals**
Gain practical exposure to advanced operational tools used to modernize renewable portfolios at scale.


## What you'll walk away with


- A fully installed and ready-to-use **GAIA Lens** **on your Google Chrome**


- A clear understanding of how GAIA Lens reads and interprets **your existing monitoring platforms**
- How to set and adjust the context (plants, timeframes, objectives) so GAIA Lens **adapts to your specific operational priorities**
- Practical workflows to investigate issues, understand performance, and prioritize actions faster
- A **live, interactive session** where you can ask questions, turn on your camera, and engage directly with our team and peers
